entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Narrow-hulled, heavily rigged sailing ships built for speed. The Cutty Sark and Flying Cloud could reach 20 knots. They raced tea from China and wool from Australia, completing the London-Sydney voyage in under 70 days.
